title: Michael's son thinks he was dropped off at Area 51
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Michael's son thinks he was dropped off at Area 51, about after 1977 at Las Vegas, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and his son his son thinks that maybe it was Area 51 where he was dropped off.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of Michael, an Air Force veteran who says he was abducted by aliens around 1977 near Las Vegas, Nevada. Michels says Michael's son thinks the place where Michael was dropped off afterward may have been Area 51, a secret US military base in the Nevada desert. If true, it would tie the abduction to the military.
